items: Voice AI ordering is already running in drive-thrus at major quick-service chains, aiming to reduce order errors, speed up service and keep upsells consistent.
Voice systems learn from interactions across all your locations, adjusting suggestions, scripts and menu boards to the customer's order and the time of day.
The strongest setup is blended: let AI take fast, common orders and promotions, and let your team handle custom requests, complaints and service recovery.
Voice is spreading beyond the speaker box into app reordering, in-car ordering, loyalty redemption and in-store kiosks, so plan every touchpoint to work by conversation.
